title: The Hungry Split
situation: Magavik is the largest tribe, yet its stores hold barely two months of food. Wigosh and Vutubour, still wary since Vutubour broke away last year, eye Magavik's fields. Elders of Magavik ask you to bless their harvest, while the smaller tribes plead for a share.

choices.label: Bless Magavik's harvest
choices.hint: The largest tribe thrives, but the others may feel forgotten and grow bitter.

choices.label: Divide the bounty among all three
choices.hint: Everyone eats a little more, though no one is truly secure and Magavik grumbles.

choices.label: Stay silent and let them sort it out
choices.hint: Hunger may press a hard choice on the tribes, and some may leave.
